sources.title: These Dongariya Kondhs Grind Their Own Business
sources.finding: Describes Mahashakti Nari Jagaran Jeevan Jivika Sangh in Baliguda, Kandhamal, and identifies members as Dongria Kondh. Named member account refers to Garbikia in Nuagoan block.
sources.decision: Community attribution needs independent verification. Do not transfer reported group or individual income to Niyamgiri growers. This is not the Marthaguda turmeric group. No income figures adopted.
